patches.name: Custom app name
patches.description: Changes the Google Photos app name in the launcher and system settings.

options.title: App name
options.description: Launcher name for the Google Photos app.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds custom Google Photos launcher branding with embedded adaptive icons (or optional custom folder).

options.title: Custom icon folder (optional)
options.description:
Optional folder containing a custom Morphe adaptive icon set.
If omitted, the built-in high quality Morphe custom branding icon is used automatically.

Supported density folders:
- mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi

Each included density folder must contain:
- morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png

Optional themed icon:
- drawable/morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml
